result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you carousel and a partially cut-off pizza card that lacks any identifying text.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the end of the visible card in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or give cards enough width/padding so full names display without clipping.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card shows only the food image, discount badge, and heart icon with no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or other details visible in the frame.
issues.suggestion: Add the restaurant name and key metadata below the image (as done for Tokumaru Ramen) so users can identify the offer without scrolling further if possible.
